versions.text: The UAV is assumed to be subjected to the unsymmetrical flight conditions of USAR.349 and USAR.351. Unbalanced aerodynamic moments about the centre of gravity must be reacted in a rational or conservative manner, considering the principal masses furnishing the reacting inertia forces.

The UA is assumed to be subjected to the asymmetrical flight conditions of USAR.349 and USAR.351 Unbalanced aerodynamic moments about the centre of gravity must be reacted in a rational or conservative manner, considering the principal masses furnishing the reacting inertia forces.
